meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Good morning. Everyone is here today, and we have the pilot readiness review.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: The central depot has confirmed the covered area booking.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: I tested the bilingual kiosk screens with six volunteers.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I fixed the QR validation bug that caused duplicate scans to appear successful.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: First, are we still using 19 November at Central Depot?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes, the transport team has reserved the space.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Then let's confirm the launch on 19 November at Central Depot.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: The volunteer feedback was mostly positive.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: One volunteer asked if a physical card would be faster than displaying a code.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: A contactless smartcard could be scanned at the gate without printing anything.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's arrange a loan NFC reader for equipment compatibility testing at the depot entrance; it will not determine the accepted fare format.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll need to check whether the reader can connect to our test equipment.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: I can ask the equipment supplier for a loan unit.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: Do we have enough time to test both the card and the QR code?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: We need a single format in the pilot build, so please flag any supplier delay immediately.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: The QR build is ready for another test, and the offline cache now holds 500 scan records.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: To be clear, we're keeping the QR ticket decision from the last meeting. QR codes remain the accepted ticket format for the pilot.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll check whether the NFC reader can be returned after the equipment test.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: That sounds sensible, but we should not confuse the volunteers with two ticket formats.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Agreed on avoiding mixed instructions. We need to settle the passenger messaging next.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: The kiosk screens already offer Marathi and English.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's also provide pilot announcements in Marathi and English, matching the two kiosk languages.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: Are we still using the signed QR payload in offline mode?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Yes, keep the offline validation approach; we'll review the security test results before launch.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: The printer supplier says the old thermal paper order can be cancelled.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: Did we ever decide on the suggestion box?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: No, it remains outside the pilot scope.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: The sunlight test passed, though one older phone had trouble focusing.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll include that limitation in the volunteer briefing.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: Who will handle the first morning's queue?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll coordinate with the depot supervisor and send the rota by Friday.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I still need the final anonymous reporting format.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's record it as a follow-up; we haven't approved a format yet.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: Fine. At least the pilot scope is much clearer now.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: The driver training checklist still needs to be prepared.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: The driver training checklist will be available in Marathi and English.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: One driver asked whether passengers could simply hand over cash while boarding.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Kabir
meeting_transcripts.content: That would be familiar to many regular passengers.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: We'll collect all pilot fares in cash as passengers board, with drivers handling the money.
